QuestInfo.name: Charms Gone Gray
QuestInfo.0: #b#p711##k has finished the lantern frames and is ready to head for the old tomb.
QuestInfo.1: The #r#o62#s#k have scattered the old name-charms all over the deep tunnels. Collect #b30 #t4000059#s#k from them in #b#m010006160##k and #b#m010006161##k, and bring them to #b#p711##k.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the #t4000059#s to #b#p711##k. While cleaning them, he found one with the same mark as the cover of #bElda#k's journal.

0.0: You're back, and you look ready this time! The frames are done. Twelve of them, light as a feather. Well, a heavy feather.
0.1: I scouted #b#m010006161##k again this morning. Bad news: the name-charms are gone from the walls. The #r#o62#s#k have been carrying them off all over the deep tunnels.
0.2: Fieldwork time! Collect #b30 #t4000059#s#k from the #r#o62#s#k. I'll clean them up with a little alchemy, and we can put them back where they belong.

yes.0: Excellent! Try #b#m010006160##k and #b#m010006161##k. The #r#o62#s#k are thick around there.

no.0: No rush. The charms have been out there for years. A few more days won't hurt.

1.0: Thirty charms! Let me just... a drop of this... and a quick rinse...
1.1: Look at that! Under all the rot, each one has a name carved into it. These aren't decorations. They're memorials.
1.2: And this one... Wait. This mark is the same as the one on the cover of #bElda#k's journal. I think this is her own charm.

item.0: I'll need #b30 #t4000059#s#k. The #r#o62#s#k in #b#m010006160##k and #b#m010006161##k have them.
